name: swissrailways
description:
Planning a trip to Switzerland? The swissrailways Connector lets you research, configure, and purchase Swiss travel passes without leaving Claude.
Whether you're looking for unlimited travel across Switzerland's trains, boats, and mountain railways, or just want a discount card for occasional trips — Claude will walk you through the options, help you compare products, and guide you step by step to a secure checkout.

What you can do:
Get personalized recommendations for Swiss Travel Pass, Swiss Travel Pass Flex, or Swiss Half Fare Card based on your travel dates and itinerary
Configure tickets for one or multiple travelers, including comfort class, duration, and applicable discounts (e.g. Family Card)
Calculate the total price in CHF, EUR, GBP, or USD before committing
Add optional cancellation protection
Receive a secure payment link from Switzerland Travel Centre — no card details ever entered in Claude

Check your order status after payment

How it works:

Claude collects your travel details through natural conversation, builds your order, and generates a payment link when you're ready. Payment is completed on Switzerland Travel Centre's secure checkout page, powered by Datatrans.
Note: Swiss Travel Pass products are only available to travelers residing outside Switzerland.
Powered by Switzerland Travel Centre — official distributor of Swiss travel passes worldwide.

_published_faq.name: How do I add swissrailways to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add swissrailways to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://anthropic.mcp.swissrailways.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is swissrailways MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, swissrailways scores 88/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the swissrailways MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: swissrailways provides these MCP tools: swissrailways_calculate_order_total_price, swissrailways_fetch_billing_person_titles, swissrailways_fetch_order_payment_systems, swissrailways_fetch_order_status, swissrailways_fetch_prices, swissrailways_fetch_ticket_options, swissrailways_get_ticket_info, and swissrailways_render_order_overview.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to swissrailways?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to swissrailways in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
swissrailways does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
swissrailways is developed by Switzerland Travel Centre. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
